rev6.release_notes: Shared simulations move like Simulate: pan (middle or Ctrl drag), turn (Shift or right drag), the wheel zooms the right way, the same view cube; the G-SEND.IO wordmark links to 3ddistributed.com/g-send.io. The Fusion add-in's Train window folds its part and check details. CAD CAM's Check for Updates can hand off to G-SEND.IO.

cadcam.release_notes: SIMULATE in the Post window opens the program in G-SEND.IO's Simulate (with G-SEND.IO 6.0.563 or newer). Enter is OK in toolpath and setup windows. The Teach window's details are folded at the bottom. Shared simulations draw each tool as Simulate does, with the G-SEND.IO logo. Tools called DOVETAIL read as grooves.
